svg.text: Print two from the model file (cad/step/picoflow-nozzle.step). They are

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the same part: jet 2's nozzle is jet 1's turned half a turn.

svg.text: Print standing on the spigot end, with supports under the saddle;

svg.text: the part fits a 167 x 130 x 244 mm space, about 300 g and 12 h each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spigot: 90 mm outside, 60 mm long, horizontal. A gentle 20 deg bend

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turns the nozzle down to the runner. Cone 170 mm long, from 90 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to 64 mm outside. Saddle: a patch 144 mm across shaped to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: housing, 6 mm thick, four 6.6 mm bolt holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tip: a 50 mm seat 25 mm deep for the insert, and two 5.6 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for M4 heat-set inserts, 28.5 mm each side of the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
